head: Somebody Feed Phil leaves Netflix; season 9 is free on YouTube in 2027
dek: After eight seasons and 49 episodes on Netflix, Somebody Feed Phil moves to YouTube: season 9 streams free on the Phil Rosenthal World channel in early 2027.
details: United Airlines is the show's new title sponsor. The move was first announced in March.
means: Fans won't need Netflix for new episodes.
todo: Subscribe to the Phil Rosenthal World YouTube channel to catch season 9.
thumb_words: SOMEBODY FEED PHIL MOVES TO YOUTUBE
